Travel and exploration

Military base: three consoles, keycard and radar airdrops

Citadel has armed guards and anti-air defenses. Guards wear green, blue or red armour by difficulty; a later update added grenades, faster reactions to sound and group attacks.

The September 2026 update added interior consoles. Activate three computers to get an access card, then use it at the central radar roof to call multiple airdrops. The card is consumed, the radar enters cooldown, and nearby players are notified.

The official support article also says guards have a chance to drop a keycard. Check their loot as another documented route. The card cannot be crafted.

Sources: official Citadel support article and 2026-09-04 official update; reviewed 2026-10-23.
